roles.label: Guest / Visitor
capabilities: View public listings and roommate profiles
Search and filter by city, locality, budget, and lifestyle
View FAQ and safety guidelines
restrictions: Cannot send connection requests (triggers AuthModal or redirects to /login)
Cannot view unmasked owner phone numbers or WhatsApp links
Cannot save/bookmark rooms or profiles (requires auth)

roles.label: Room Seeker / Flatmate
roles.prerequisites: Firebase Auth user with users/{uid}.role == 'seeker' and users/{uid}.onboardingComplete == true
capabilities: Full marketplace discovery: browse rooms, roommates, and PG listings
10-point compatibility score calculated dynamically against every roommate and room
Send up to 5 free connection requests (FREE_CONNECT_LIMIT = 5)
Unlock chat and direct phone/WhatsApp contact once a request is accepted
Save rooms and flatmates to private lists
Create co-living groups via CreateTeamModal (housingIntent: 'team_up')
Submit Aadhaar / DigiLocker Tier 2 verification
Report suspicious listings or abusive users
Write reviews on listings and flatmates
restrictions: Cannot access /owner-dashboard or /create-listing (redirected by OnboardingGuard to /explore?tab=rooms)
Cannot write directly to the 'listings' collection (rejected by Firestore rules: request.auth.uid == resource.data.ownerId)

roles.label: Flat / Property Owner
roles.prerequisites: Firebase Auth user with users/{uid}.role == 'owner' and users/{uid}.onboardingComplete == true
capabilities: Create, edit, pause, and delete property listings in 'listings' collection
Access /owner-dashboard (overview metrics, weekly view trends Recharts, applicant queue, flatmate discovery)
View, rank, evaluate fit, and screen incoming applicants
Access custom screening questionnaire answers for applicants
Accept or decline connection requests
Chat with accepted applicants and share verified phone details
Submit Tier 3 property ownership proof (electricity bill, property tax receipt, sale deed) to get 'Owner Verified' badge
Confirm listing availability freshness (updates lastConfirmedAt)
Use /applicant-compare for side-by-side candidate evaluation
restrictions: Cannot be listed in the seeker pool for roommate matching (filtered out by roleFiltering.ts)
Cannot write to admin collections or approve own verification
Cannot publish listings with negative rent or deposit values (enforced by firestore.rules)

roles.label: System Administrator
roles.prerequisites: Email present in hardcoded whitelist (adminKeys.ts) or document exists in admins/{email} collection with role == 'admin'
capabilities: Full access to /admin suite: dashboard, users, listings, verifications, reports, notifications, marketplace, settings
Approve or reject owner verification documents (sets ownerVerified: true on listings)
Suspend, ban, or reactivate user accounts (users/{uid}.status = 'suspended' | 'active')
Delete or pause any listing across the entire platform
Resolve or dismiss user reports in 'reports' collection
Send system-wide broadcast notifications to all users or specific roles
Add or remove admins and moderators
Execute Clean Demo & Seed Data (purge docs tagged with seed_user_)
Execute Nuclear Database Wipe / Factory Reset
restrictions: Cannot modify privateUserData subcollections without legitimate administrative rationale

roles.label: Content Moderator
capabilities: Access /admin reports queue and verifications queue
Review reported content and flag suspicious accounts
Approve or reject pending verifications
restrictions: Cannot access AdminSettings (admin user management or database wipe)

lifecycleStates.description: Visitor has not signed in with Firebase Auth. Stored state: user == null.
lifecycleStates.nextTransition: Signs in via Google Sign-In -> AUTHENTICATED_NO_PROFILE

lifecycleStates.description: User is signed in via Firebase Auth, but no users/{uid} document exists yet.
users/{uid} document exists, but onboardingComplete == false.
lifecycleStates.nextTransition: Submits onboarding questionnaire -> ONBOARDED_SEEKER or ONBOARDED_OWNER

lifecycleStates.description: Seeker with completed profile, target city/localities, budget, and >= 5 quiz answers.
lifecycleStates.allowedRoutes: All PUBLIC, AUTH_REQUIRED, and ONBOARDED_SEEKER / ONBOARDED_ANY routes.

lifecycleStates.description: Property owner with verified role and city set in profile.
lifecycleStates.allowedRoutes: All PUBLIC, AUTH_REQUIRED, and ONBOARDED_OWNER / ONBOARDED_ANY routes.

lifecycleStates.description: users/{uid}.status == 'suspended' set by an admin. Blocked from platform interactions.
lifecycleStates.enforcement: src/lib/accountStatus.ts and firestore.rules (isActiveUser() check rejects writes)

trustTiers.name: Basic Verified
trustTiers.requirement: User authenticated via Google OAuth with verified email.

trustTiers.name: Identity Verified
trustTiers.requirement: Completed Aadhaar OTP or DigiLocker verification submission.

trustTiers.name: Verified Property Owner
trustTiers.requirement: Owner submitted electricity bill / property deed approved by Admin in AdminVerifications.
